mapper.select: SELECT conversation_id, summary_text, summarized_through_sequence_number, updated_at FROM assistant_conversation_summaries WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assistant_conversation_summaries ( conversation_id, summary_text, summarized_through_sequence_number, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{conversationId}, #{summaryText}, #{summarizedThroughSequenceNumber}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (conversation_id) DO UPDATE SET summary_text = excluded.summary_text, summarized_through_sequence_number = excluded.summarized_through_sequence_number, updated_at = excluded.updated_at
